sources_used: mytimeactive.co.uk / Bandai Namco Arcade Allies (Pavilion Bromley)

findings.name: Tenpin Milton Keynes
findings.evidence_quote: Games list (updated 2023-10-11): Cruis'n Blast; Super Bikes 3; Jurassic Park Arcade (2015); Carnival Wheel; Connect 4 Hoops HD; Down The Clown; Grand Piano Keys; Monopoly Pusher (6P); Monopoly Roll & Go; Pac-Man Roller; Red Zone Rush; Space Invaders Frenzy. No music/rhythm titles.
findings.note: New Tenpin (opened 2023). ZIv inventory is redemption/racing only.

findings.name: Tenpin Nantgarw
findings.evidence_quote: Information: 'A lot of raw thrills cabs, hockey table games, general redemption games and such'. Games (updated 2024-06-05): Cruis'n Blast; Hot Wheels; Super Bikes 3; Halo Fireteam Raven; Jurassic Park; Walking Dead; Space Invaders Frenzy; Typhoon. No music games.
findings.note: Typical Tenpin Raw Thrills/redemption mix; no PIU/DDR on current list.

findings.name: Tenpin Northampton
findings.evidence_quote: Games (updated 2022-12-14): Tomb Raider Arcade; Cruis'n Blast; Halo Fireteam Raven (4P); Down The Clown; Monopoly Pusher (8P); Spinner Frenzy; PAC-MAN Basket; Pac-Man Smash. No music games.
findings.note: Inventory non-rhythm only; older update so confidence not certain.

findings.name: Tenpin Nottingham
findings.evidence_quote: Information (updated 2024-07-16): 'Fusion finally put out of its misery as of 2022. Place received a £500k revamp and they have perhaps wisely downsized + moved the arcade area'. Current games list is racing/redemption only (Cruis'n, Mario Kart, Halo, etc.); no Fusion/DDR.
findings.note: Positive removal of Fusion (UK dance cab). Historical DDR/Fusion comments are years old.

findings.name: Tenpin Parrs Wood Manchester
findings.evidence_quote: Information: 'Just the general bowling alley games, no more DDR'. Games list: Super Bikes 3; Claw Machine; Monopoly Pusher; NERF Arcade; Red Zone Rush; Spinner Frenzy; Wheel of Fortune; Storm; Venturer S2.
findings.note: Explicit ZIv note that DDR is gone; old Euromix2 photo is historical only.

findings.name: Tenpin Plymouth Barbican
findings.evidence_quote: Information: 'Update from someone else: I went in and I think they removed the pump infinity cab (I was told it moved to Manchester)'. Comment 1 month ago: 'Does anyone know if they've got a new cab to replace the Pump one that's gone?' Current games list has no PIU/music titles.
findings.note: Pump Infinity historically present then removed; recent ZIv comment confirms still gone.

findings.name: Tenpin Rochdale
findings.evidence_quote: Games (updated 2020-01-31): MotoGP Arcade; Pac-Man Swirl; Spinner Frenzy only. No music games listed.
findings.note: Very sparse 2020 inventory; no positive no-rhythm statement. Treat as weak confirmed_none from listed cabs only.

findings.name: Tenpin Southampton
findings.evidence_quote: Comment (2 years ago): 'i asked the staff about new arcade cabs and they said anything new and fancy will be here im expecting a smx dx to possibly appear but as of feb 28th there are no new cabs'. Games list: Cruis'n Blast; MotoGP; Crossy Road; Deal Or No Deal Pusher only.
findings.note: Staff/player note that no SMX/rhythm had appeared after refit; current list non-rhythm.

findings.name: Tenpin Southport
findings.evidence_quote: Games (updated 2025-06-14): Tomb Raider Arcade; Mario Kart Arcade GP DX; MotoGP Arcade; Jurassic Park Arcade (2015); Hamster's Ball; Space Invaders Frenzy; Spinner Frenzy. No music games. Old Premier Bowl EM2 photos are historical.
findings.note: Recent 2025 inventory; historical EM2 photos not current.

findings.name: Tenpin Stafford
findings.evidence_quote: Games (updated 2022-08-30): Minecraft Dungeons Arcade; Cruis'n Blast only. No music games.
findings.note: Tiny listed inventory; may be incomplete. No positive music-game removal note.

findings.name: Tenpin Stoke
findings.evidence_quote: Information: 'Used to have PIU Prime.' Comment by yipster (~7y): 'They removed the PIU cab due to the music unfamiliarity which meant less people were playing on the cab.' Current games (2023-09-18): Injustice; Cruis'n Blast; Super Bikes 3; Jurassic Park; Crossy Road; Pac-Man Swirl; Spongebob pusher; PAC-MAN Basket.
findings.note: Positive PIU removal; current list has no rhythm titles.

findings.name: Tenpin Swansea
findings.evidence_quote: Information: 'Has a standard arcade, but still no DDR'. Games: Cruis'n Blast; Super Bikes 3; Halo Fireteam Raven; Walking Dead; Crossy Road; Grand Piano Keys; Spinner Frenzy.
findings.note: Explicit 'still no DDR' on ZIv. Update is older; no counter-evidence found of later music installs.

findings.name: Tenpin Swindon
findings.evidence_quote: Games (updated 2020-01-31): World's Largest Pac-Man; Cruis'n Blast x2; Halo Fireteam Raven; Jurassic Park; Walking Dead; Spinner Frenzy. No music games.
findings.note: 2020 inventory only; no explicit no-rhythm statement.

findings.name: Tenpin Telford
findings.evidence_quote: Games (updated 2023-09-08) after refurb: extensive list of redemption/racing (Cruis'n, Super Bikes, Halo, Jurassic Park, NERF, Pac-Man pushers/smash/baller, Spinner Frenzy, etc.). No music/rhythm titles.
findings.note: Substantial post-refurb inventory with no rhythm machines.

findings.name: Tenpin Trinity Walk - Wakefield
findings.evidence_quote: Fresh 2026 inventory (updated 2026-06-25): Hungry Hungry Hippos; Fast & Furious Arcade (2022); Rush and Catch; Super Bikes 3; Ball Madness; Connect 4 Hoops HD; Derby Day; Down The Clown; Find A Key Deluxe; NERF Arcade; Space Invaders Frenzy; Spinner Frenzy; Whack N Win; Typhoon; Boxer; PAC-MAN Baller; World Football Pro; Pac-Man Pinger. No music games.
findings.note: Very recent full inventory by ZIv regular; pure FEC/redemption.

findings.name: Tenpin Walsall
findings.evidence_quote: Information: 'The usual redemption and arcade fare.' Games (2023-04-26): Hungry Hungry Hippos; Cruis'n Blast; Mario Kart GP DX; Super Bikes 3; claws; Grand Piano Keys; Monopoly/Pac-Man pushers; Red Zone Rush; Space Invaders Frenzy; Whack N Win; Wheel of Fortune; Storm; Joker's Wild. No music games.
findings.note: Standard Tenpin redemption mix.

findings.name: Tenpin Warrington
findings.evidence_quote: Information: 'Totally refurbished, arcade is only in the front now, many new standard arcade games (tho no returned DDR still). Back section where DDR, bar, pool and go karts were is now a new reception...' Games: Photobooth; Jurassic Park Arcade (2015).
findings.note: Explicit 'no returned DDR still' after rebrand from LA Bowl.

findings.name: Tenpin Wrexham
findings.evidence_quote: Information (updated 2023-09-08): 'Arcade is smaller now, with the usual racing, shoot'ems, and redemption games. No more DDR, now a very large area of pool tables'. Games: Tomb Raider; Cruis'n Blast; MotoGP; Super Bikes 3; Circus Ball Drop; DC Superheroes Pusher; PAC-MAN Basket; Pac-Man Smash.
findings.note: Explicit 'No more DDR'.

findings.name: Tenpin Xscape Castleford
findings.evidence_quote: Information: 'Bowling alley in Xscape with redemption machines offering tickets and prizes. There are also Raw Thrill and air hockey games at this location.' Large games list (2023-08-31) is racing/redemption only; no music titles.
findings.note: Large FEC inventory without rhythm machines.

findings.name: Tenpin York
findings.evidence_quote: Games (updated 2020-01-31): Cruis'n Blast; MotoGP Arcade; Halo Fireteam Raven; Jurassic Park Arcade (2015); Down The Clown; Pac-Man Smash. No music games.
findings.note: Older 2020 list only.

findings.name: The Arcade Warehouse North Shields
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game section (updated 2025-07-08): 'Guitar Hero Arcade (International) - Work surprisingly well for how much use it gets.'; 'StepMania Converted Cabinet (International) - Bad setlist and terrible sync. It is somewhat playable though and has a couple classics like Dynamite Rave and Captain Jack.'
findings.note: StepMania is a converted pad cab running StepMania software (not official StepManiaX hardware); mapped to stepmaniax as nearest dance-pad slug. Guitar Hero Arcade mapped to other (not a Bemani slug). Free-play timed sessions; machines often scuffed per ZIv comments.

findings.name: The Arkade
findings.evidence_quote: Games (updated 2026-03-22): pinball (Attack from Mars, Indiana Jones, Judge Dredd, Road Show, Twilight Zone, Who Dunnit); racers (Crazy Taxi, Battle Gear 3, Daytona Championship USA, NITRO SPEED, Outrun 2016, Sega Rally 2); shooters/redemption (Big Buck Safari, Deal or No Deal, Sonic Sports Basketball, Wild West Shootout, Alpine Racer 2, Sonic Kids Basketball). No rhythm/music titles.
findings.note: Minehead seafront tourist arcade; recent full list is retro/pinball/racing only.

findings.name: The Boulevard
findings.evidence_quote: Games (updated 2020-09-26): OutRun 2; Sega Touring Car Championship; Point Blank; Rambo; Time Crisis 3. No music games.
findings.note: Lowestoft; older partial list of video/racing/shooters only.

findings.name: The Bright Spot
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv page created/updated 2025-12-29: 'No games at this location.' Address 1 West Parade, Rhyl LL18 1HD; hours Mon-Sun 10:00-22:00. No cab list or music-game notes.
findings.note: Empty ZIv stub; no web inventory found. Seaside amusement site type unknown for rhythm.

findings.name: The Bright Spot Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Comment by sansyy (~1 year ago): 'Visited a week ago, DDR cab is gone (and when asking the operators they didn't even know what DDR was!) so I am presuming it's been gone for a while'. Current games: NASCAR Racing; Aliens Extermination; Jurassic Park Arcade; Deal or No Deal; Pac-Man Pusher; Pac-Man Ticket Mania; Sonic Sports Air Hockey.
findings.note: Wallasey New Brighton; positive visitor confirmation DDR removed.

findings.name: The Centre for Computing History
findings.evidence_quote: Permanent games: Centipede; Street Fighter II Hyper Fighting; Pandora's Box 4; Sega Mega-Tech; Alien Syndrome; Space Invaders. Information: 'Arcade games present but not on permanent display include ... and Percussion Master.' No DDR/Bemani on permanent floor.
findings.note: Cambridge computing museum; permanent lineup is classic arcade. Percussion Master only as occasional/event display, not permanent map target. Free-play with admission.

findings.name: The Dunes Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Games (updated 2023-12-05): Mario Kart GP DX; Sega Rally 3; Super Bikes 2; Walking Dead; Coconut Shy; Deal or No Deal; Jurassic World Fallen Kingdom; Slam 'n' Jam Jr.; Stack 'N' Grab; Stacker; Space Invaders Frenzy. Old comment: 'The SN has been sold/traded'. No current music games.
findings.note: South Shields Dunes Adventure Island; SuperNOVA historically sold off; current list FEC only.

findings.name: The Flamingo
findings.evidence_quote: Games (updated 2023-08-10): only Cruis'n Blast and MotoGP Arcade listed. No music games on page, but inventory is clearly incomplete for a Great Yarmouth Marine Parade arcade.
findings.note: Sparse ZIv listing only; cannot honestly call confirmed_none without fuller inventory.

findings.name: The Four Quarters
findings.evidence_quote: Official multi-site games list includes: 'Dancing Stage Euromix' at Peckham; 'Dancing Stage Euromix' at Elephant and Castle; 'Guitar Hero' at Peckham. Shard address 189 Rye Lane is the Peckham branch.
findings.note: Peckham (189 Rye Lane). Dancing Stage Euromix is European DDR; Guitar Hero mapped to other. ZIv page (2019) is outdated and omits current dance cabs. Do not merge other FQ branches into this sid.

findings.name: The Kingpin Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Information (updated 2025-04-05): 'Arcade with bowling and American-style cafe. Lots of redemption, a few videos, no rhythm games though. Owned by the Taylor Made Fun operators...'
findings.note: Cleethorpes; explicit positive 'no rhythm games though' from recent ZIv editor.

findings.name: The Light Stockport
findings.evidence_quote: Games (updated 2024-10-20): Avengers (Pro) pinball; Daytona Championship USA (New Season Edition); Storm Racer G; House of the Dead Scarlet Dawn; Down The Clown; Whack-A-Clown. No music games. Information: 'Arcade opened up in the Cinema.'
findings.note: Small cinema-attached arcade; racing/shooter/redemption only.

findings.name: The Mint
findings.evidence_quote: Information (page updated 2023-10-27): 'Don't be fooled by the patched SuperNOVA decal's on one of the two machines, as that machine is infact still running EuroMIX software.' Games section currently shows 'No games at this location.'
findings.note: Great Yarmouth Marine Parade Mint. ZIv editorial claims two dance machines with Euromix under SuperNOVA shells, but games table empty. Treat as has_games ddr with low confidence until a current visit confirms.

findings.name: The Mint
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv (updated 2018-08-11): 'No games at this location.' Address only 'Ingoldmells Lincolnshire'. No website, hours, or cab notes.
findings.note: Empty stub; not the same venue as Cleethorpes or Great Yarmouth Mint branches.

findings.name: The Mint
findings.evidence_quote: Information: 'By the pier's entrance, on the other side of the road from Kingpin and Fantasy World. Appears to have more coin pushers + gambling machines than Kingpin...' Games: Minecraft Dungeons Arcade; Mario Kart GP DX; Aliens Armageddon; Jurassic Park Arcade; Luigi's Mansion Arcade. No music games.
findings.note: Cleethorpes Pier Pavilion Mint (Taylor Made Fun). Sister Kingpin explicitly has no rhythm; this list is video/redemption only.

findings.name: The Mirage
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv (created/updated 2024-05-19): 'No games at this location.' Beach Road, Hemsby. Hours Mon-Sun 09:00-23:00. No cab inventory.
findings.note: Empty ZIv entry; no independent rhythm-game evidence found.

findings.name: The Needles Landmark Attraction
findings.evidence_quote: Information (updated 2024-08-17): 'Small arcade, usual non-ticket redemption, previously had EM2 but now gone'. Games: Dead Heat; Ford Racing Full Blown; Sega Rally 3; Luigi's Mansion; Operation G.H.O.S.T.; Transformers Human Alliance; claws; Key Master; Sonic Sports Air Hockey/Basketball; Mario & Sonic Rio 2016.
findings.note: Isle of Wight Alum Bay; positive EM2 removal note.

findings.name: The Pavilion | Mytime Active Bromley
findings.evidence_quote: Information: 'Dancing Stage EuroMIX is in this establishment as well as the other games you come to expect.' Games table (updated 2024-04-19) lists Animal Kaiser PLUS, Cruis'n Blast, Dead Heat, X Games Snowboarder, Aliens Armageddon, Jurassic Park, claws, Whack em Funky Gators, hockey tables, but does not list the Euromix cab in the games section.
findings.note: Venue open (Mytime Active / Bandai Namco cashless arcade refit coverage 2025). Euromix claimed in ZIv info but not in games table; post-refit status of dance cab unconfirmed. Confidence unverified.

findings.name: The Pier Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Information (updated 2025-08-13 by leo77): 'Not a particularly great location. The single machine with screen burn in on the left hand side of the screen. Pads give misses and crap every so often. Usually has sand all over the pads. Fairly easy to find, just inside of the middle doors.' Games section empty but prose describes a pad dance cabinet.
findings.note: Saltburn pier. Pad language implies DDR/Dancing Stage style cab; software version not stated. Mapped to ddr as UK seaside standard for pad cabs.

findings.name: The Royal Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Information: 'Small arcade Owned by HB Leisure.' Games: Men In Black; Ben Bones; Deal Or No Deal Pusher (8P); Hamster's Ball; Pink Panther Jewel Heist; Skill Cut Winner; Spongebob Pirates of Bikini Bottom. Comment by StaticFish (~1y): 'Not a lot to see here (In terms of video games), only had a brief visit'.
findings.note: Llandudno Mostyn Street; redemption-focused, no rhythm on list.
